outflowClustersMethod: single-linkage of msk==3 cell centres within 1500 m; hourly restart flux, trapezoid from 2026-11-01T18:00Z

balanceInputsWholeRunOutflowFromFirstRes.inflowVolumeBasis: trapezoid over sfincs.dis (the solver interpolates linearly between the hourly values)
balanceInputsWholeRunOutflowFromFirstRes.residualNote: inflow + rain - infiltration - storageEnd - outflow(from first restart). An estimate, not a bound: the outflow term is a trapezoid over hourly snapshots of the instantaneous flux (not a time integral of the solver flux), so its sampling error has either sign; any outflow before the first restart would make the residual more negative by that amount

outflowBeforeFirstRestart.why: no his output; map frames start 2026-11-01T17:00Z; hourly restarts start 2026-11-01T18:00Z
outflowBeforeFirstRestart.upperBoundNote: inflow + rain before the first restart minus storage then, taking infiltration before it as zero (it is not zero, so the bound is loose) and the pre-restart numerical residual as small; trueResidualRangeM3 inherits the hourly-sampling estimate in the outflow term after the first restart, so both ends are estimates

rainStageIV07to18Z.mapFramesNote: precipitation_rate in the map is a 15-min sample of the applied rate, so integrating the frames only approximates the applied rain; cumprcp is the solver total
rainStageIV07to18Z.note: mesh-area-weighted is the rain the model receives; the HRAP cell mean is an unweighted mean over the mapped Stage IV cells; the bbox mean is an unweighted mean over the 1 km precip_2d grid

negativeDepth.note: vol/area of subgrid_volume; the live verifier rejects depth < -0.001 m
